Designing digital experiences that feel effortless®

I am Zunair Mehboob, a UI/UX and graphic designer with 4 years of experience. I turn ideas into clean, functional and beautiful experiences, always focused on users and real problems.

I deliberately take no shortcuts in my work. Every project goes through the same process: research, moodboard, wireframes, design system, because skipping steps is how you end up with a screen instead of an experience. The answer is built around three things: the people who use it, the problem it solves, and the clarity of every detail. When those three align, a design stops being decoration and starts being felt.

[ Design chemistry ]

Clarity Before Aesthetics

Most projects start with a moodboard. I start with questions. Before a color is chosen or a typeface is pulled, I map the goals, the users and the problems worth solving, so the design that comes out the other side is not decorated. It is argued.

Design as a System

A screen is not a product. A product is every touchpoint working as one coherent world, from a landing page to an app flow to a social post. I design systems that scale without breaking and flex without losing character.

Built to Be Felt

The best experiences do not explain themselves, they are felt. I work until the design does something a brief never can: make someone feel something before they read a single word.
